trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/7954587 with trailing identifier 7954587. Direct access to the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge, so resolver metadata was queried through the zbMATH REST API.

Access failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted and metadata_only. zbMATH metadata identified DOI 10.1214/24-STS956, title 'Rejoinder: Protocols for Observational Studies: Methods and Open Problems', and a Project Euclid full-text URL. The Project Euclid page returned an Incapsula challenge, Crossref exposed only resolver metadata pointing back to Project Euclid, and OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false with no best OA location or PDF URL.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact title, exact DOI, and exact title plus PDF. Candidate pages were rejected because they were metadata-only records, blocked publisher pages, fetch-failing issue PDFs, or different works such as the non-rejoinder arXiv article 'Protocols for Observational Studies: Methods and Open Problems'. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source for the rejoinder was recovered.
